data.exact_reserve_text:
The 2019 & prior year of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a cumulative GAAP profit of GBP 14,362,000 (2018 & prior years of account - GBP 9,594,000) and a distributable profit of GBP 13,618,000 (2018 & prior years of account - GBP 9,800,000).
The 2019 & prior years of account distributable profit of GBP 13,618,000 consists of:
 A cumulative GAAP profit of GBP 19,001,000 in respect of 2019 pure year of account.
 A cumulative GAAP loss of GBP (4,640,000) in respect of 2018 & prior years of accounts movements in 2021 principally as a result of strengthening the Casualty UK account following an in depth assessment of the reserves by the PMA actuarial function.
 An adjustment for distribution purposes of GBP (743,000) in respect of the reversal of the impact on the prior year unearned premium and pipeline premium assessed at this year-end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Strengthening of reserves in 2018 & prior years principally due to an in-depth actuarial reassessment of the Casualty UK account performed in 2021.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net adverse prior-year reserve development of approximately GBP 5.6m (gross) at 31 December 2021 (c. 3.4% of opening gross claims outstanding). The movement was driven principally by strengthening in the Casualty (UK) reserves following an in-depth actuarial reassessment, together with movements across older underwriting years evident in the claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: strengthening the Casualty UK account following an in depth assessment of the reserves by the PMA actuarial function.
The 2021 pure year of account has developed favourably to date with a Gross Earned Loss Ratio at 46.7% and the Syndicate has benefited from a benign year with minimal large loss activity.
an adjustment for distribution purposes of GBP (743,000) in respect of the reversal of the impact on the prior year unearned premium and pipeline premium assessed at this year-end.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (GBP 5.614m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2019 (triangle is presented in GBP 000). No explicit single-line 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was present; year-of-account GAAP breakdown references a GBP 4.64m GAAP loss for 2018 & prior related to Casualty UK strengthening which is directionally consistent but not identical to the triangle-derived total. A Part VII transfer (Lloyd's Brussels) occurred in 2020; the report states the scheme had no economic impact on the Syndicate. Prior-year movement used the triangle as the primary numeric source (confidence 0.8).
